description: Applications do not validate input data before processing, creating vulnerability to injection attacks. This signal indicates that SQL injection, XSS, and command injection vulnerabilities may exist.
applicability: Applicable to all applications accepting user input. Includes web applications, APIs, command-line tools, and any software processing external data.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through application security testing, code review, and input validation assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Information Integrity
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
